claims.quote: The New Guinea rainbowfish, Melanotaenia affinis, is a rainbowfish from Papua New Guinea.

regions.name: Sepik River
regions.quote: The "Pagwi" form has a very limited distribution, being known only from a tributary of the Sepik River in New Guinea, while the "Bluewater Creek" form has only been collected from a single location close to Madang, in Papua New Guinea.
